pricing.context_threshold_scope: Per model request, using full input. More than 272000 input tokens reprices the full request. Aggregate turn input is not one model request.
pricing.input_partition: ordinary_input_tokens = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens - cache_write_input_tokens; ordinary, cache-read and cache-write prices are alternatives, not additive.
pricing.output_partition: Reasoning output is already included in output_tokens and must not be added again.

pricing.native_usage_caveat: Codex 0.159.2 JSONL reports cache_write_input_tokens, but its wire parser defaults a missing upstream cache_write_tokens field to zero. A reported zero does not prove upstream explicit zero.
pricing.cache_write_sensitivity: Report native-reported W point estimate and an all-noncached-input-written sensitivity: set W = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens. This is a hypothetical upper scenario under the same tariff, not observed billing.

limitations: All USD values are published API-price equivalents, not measured billing or subscription charges.
Native-reported cache writes may default upstream omissions to zero; show conservative write sensitivity, not certainty about provider cache creation.
No point estimate is invented when writes are absent, usage is incomplete, or short-context pricing cannot be established.

Every attempted row supplied in report.runs contributes to the numerator; any unknown supplied attempt makes the whole-arm total and cost per success unavailable. Callers must include every attempt; this parser cannot discover omitted retries or supplementary ledgers.
Reasoning output is included in output, and cached reads/writes are included in total input; none are counted twice.
Ten fresh tasks, one balanced trial per arm, synthetic small repositories, and uncontrolled backend/OS caches limit generalization; the range is not statistical uncertainty.
Local CPU/RSS/time overhead is reported but has no attributable dollar rate and is not included as fabricated spending. Peak RSS totals have no physical interpretation.
Requested default service tier is frozen; realized provider tier/routing and actual per-request model calls are unavailable from this stream.

measurement_scope.attempt_coverage_scope: All 20 planned originals match durable saved runs and the primary report; supplementary ledger is empty. Separate independent runtime audit checks the durable event chain.

interpretation.conclusion: The pooled native-reported API-price equivalent is 2.28% lower for B, but Memglide-preloaded tasks are 4.43% more expensive. Identical-prompt controls account for the pooled saving. This study does not establish money savings caused by Memglide.
interpretation.controls_interpretation: The two controls bypass Memglide source preparation and deliver byte-identical prompts. Their 33.27% price-equivalent difference demonstrates uncontrolled run/cache variation; it cannot be credited to retrieval or source preparation.
interpretation.focused_interpretation: Across eight preloaded tasks, mean price equivalent is $0.04209265 with Memglide versus $0.0403054 with bare Codex, a 4.43% increase. Four single-source pairs are descriptively 24.14% cheaper while four integration pairs are 26.08% dearer; one trial per task cannot establish those mechanisms or predict future work.
interpretation.paired_interpretation: B is cheaper in five pairs and dearer in five. All pairs are retained. Individual favorable and unfavorable deltas exceed the net pooled saving in magnitude, so the small aggregate is sensitive to individual tasks.
interpretation.cost_change_explanation: 902 fewer output tokens reduce the price equivalent by $0.00902. 134 more ordinary uncached tokens add $0.000268; 1,792 fewer cached tokens remove $0.0001792. These sum to $0.0089312 less over ten successes, mainly the output difference. Native-reported writes are zero in every run, subject to producer-default ambiguity.
interpretation.recommendation: Treat compact source preparation as an experimental option; do not advertise proven cost savings. Repeat fresh paired workloads, especially integrations and identical-context controls, before choosing a default or making causal economic claims.
interpretation.statistical_scope: One balanced repeat of ten small synthetic tasks; no statistical evidence of general savings. Independent write-attribution sensitivity spans a 15.47% increase through a 16.99% saving and is not a confidence interval.
